title: presidio-hardened/trust-store@1
description: Verifier-side trust store, keyed by signer id. A bare string value is an HMAC-SHA256 secret (back-compat; arbitrary UTF-8, not hex). An object declares the signer's algorithm and key material; key material may be a single string or a list (key rotation: any listed key may verify). Ed25519 public keys MUST be 64 lowercase hex chars (32 raw bytes) — enforced fail-closed at verification time, not schema time, matching the ikigov-assess consumer (ADR-0001 D3). 'public_key' and 'key' are accepted interchangeably as fallbacks, mirroring the consumer's normalisation.
